#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
bash resources/file_check.sh

import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
all_sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)
for name, df in all_sheets.items():
    print(f"=== Sheet: {name} ===")
    print(df.to_string())
    print()

from openpyxl import load_workbook

wb = load_workbook("budget.xlsx", data_only=True)
for name in wb.sheetnames:
    ws = wb[name]
    print(f"=== Sheet: {name} (dims: {ws.dimensions}) ===")
    for row in ws.iter_rows(values_only=True):
        print(row)
    print()
